name: Ashida and Badla Octree Contouring
definition: A method that extracts contours directly from octrees with adaptive resolution by identifying cycles of contour faces intersecting each octree cell and creating one vertex for each cycle.
summary: Ashida and Badla Octree Contouring extracts adaptive-resolution contours directly from octrees by creating one vertex per contour face cycle, avoiding uniform grids or dual hexahedral meshes.
